$comment: Maximal valid Decision Mode rules object. Every property the schema declares is exercised. The top-level $comment and the nested _note below are load-bearing: they prove the annotation namespace survives, so this fixture must keep both.

quorum._note: a real participation floor, not the 0 sentinel -- 0 would be legal but would not prove the bound accepts ordinary values.

voting._note: threshold is set explicitly at the inclusive floor the majority arm allows; the arm constrains the value without requiring the key, so both the present and absent forms are legal here.

objection_handling._note: all three properties set explicitly, including the finalize_decline action that is only expressible from schema_version 2.

evaluation._note: minimum_confidence at a real floor rather than the 0 sentinel.

commitment._note: the SATISFIED case of the designated_role arm -- the invalid-*-rules corpora pin the two ways it rejects, this pins the way it accepts.
